reviewMethod: Independently visually inspected every original paper page and scheme PDF pages 1–32; task boundaries follow detailed scales. Original typeset questions and complete worked solutions/credit notes retained. All 21 finite selections for Q3(b)(ii) generated mechanically. Publication follows the current one-card-per-printed-choice policy; legacy routes and source checks are retained in choice-policy.json.
sourceNotes: Q3(b)(ii): choose five of seven labelled numbers A–G; all C(7,5)=21 routes retain 5C. Their tariffs are alternatives, not a 105-mark question.

Q5(a)–(c) is one holistic 25C task: the SEC explicitly focuses on syllabus-related skills and grants full credit for consistently displaying them. All three model solutions and the exceptional marking rule are retained.
Only Q1(d), Q3(a), Q4(a), Q4(c), Q7(b), Q7(e) permit Full Credit minus one.
Q7 shared carry-forward instructions accompany all affected tasks. Original diagrams, tables, number line and prior context are preserved.
